offline.title: Offline vocabulary review
offline.intro: Download up to 100 due cards while connected. Reviews stay on this device until synced to your account.
offline.pendingBeforeDownload: Sync or resolve pending reviews before downloading a new deck.
offline.login: Log in to download and sync
offline.storageError: Your browser does not allow offline storage.
offline.conflicts: {count} reviews conflict with changes made on another device. These reviews have not been applied.
offline.discard: Discard conflicting reviews to reload cards
offline.saveError: Could not save this review on your device. Please try again.
offline.finished: You've reviewed this downloaded deck. Sync and download a fresh deck when connected.
offline.empty: No offline deck yet. Log in and download cards while connected.
offline.privacy: Cards are stored in this browser and removed on logout. XP is recorded after successful sync.

release.title: A clearer path to daily progress
release.intro: New tools help you continue your study session, practise your own mistakes and prepare for real situations.
release.once: Shown once per version in this browser. Reopen it from your account menu or the updates page.

dailySession.title: Short daily study sessions
dailySession.body: A checklist of about 15 minutes from Smart Review, with progress saved to your account.

errorNotebook.title: Your personal error notebook
errorNotebook.body: Practise corrections from writing and games, then revisit them with spaced repetition.

offline.title: Vocabulary practice offline
offline.body: Download cards to this browser, review offline and sync when connected again.

practicePacks.title: Prepare for life in Germany
practicePacks.body: Three paths: Ausbildung interviews, finding housing and workplace communication.

reliability.title: More reliable learning progress
reliability.body: Improved login sessions, XP updates and payment processing.

newGames.title: 6 new learning adventures
newGames.body: 6 A1–B2 games: Sentence Builder, Word Connections, Grammar Detective, Plurals, Word Families and Dialogue Quest. Get explanations and review mistakes.

adaptiveGames.title: Real-life topics and suitable difficulty
adaptiveGames.body: The game bank grows from 144 to 864 questions with five new topics: shopping, health, housing, apprenticeships and work. Signed-in learners can use recent results and mistakes to choose suitable questions.

learning.loadError: Could not load the data. Please try again.
learning.title: Today's study session
learning.intro: Open each activity, return here and mark it complete. Progress is saved to your account.
learning.saved: Leave and return whenever you need to continue.
learning.target: Aim for about {count} cards within this time.
learning.saveError: Progress could not be saved. Please try again.
learning.checklistNote: You mark this personal checklist yourself. Each activity awards its own XP; checking a step gives no additional XP.
learning.fullPlan: See the full Smart Review plan
learning.packsIntro: Combine vocabulary, speaking and writing around one situation. Progress is saved; AI tools use your current plan limits.

ausbildung.title: Ausbildung interview
ausbildung.intro: Introduce yourself, discuss your motivation and write an application.
ausbildung.vocabulary: Find and learn words about Ausbildung, experience and motivation.
ausbildung.speaking: Choose an interview scenario. Introduce yourself and explain your career choice.
ausbildung.writing: Write an Ausbildung application email, describe your experience and request an interview.

housing.title: Finding housing
housing.intro: Ask about an apartment, arrange a viewing and email a landlord.
housing.vocabulary: Learn Wohnung, Miete, Kaution and Nebenkosten.
housing.speaking: Choose a housing scenario. Ask about rent, deposit and viewing dates.
housing.writing: Write an email asking about an apartment and suggesting a viewing date.

work.title: Workplace communication
work.intro: Discuss work schedules, ask for help and email a colleague.
work.vocabulary: Learn Arbeit, Termin, Aufgabe and Besprechung.
work.speaking: Choose a workplace scenario. Ask a colleague for help and confirm a deadline.
work.writing: Write a colleague an email to agree on a meeting and tasks.

notebook.title: Your error notebook
notebook.intro: Revisit mistakes from your writing. Suggested corrections you remember move further apart; missed ones return in 10 minutes.
notebook.reviewError: Could not save this review. Refresh the notebook and try again.
notebook.tryAgain: Read the correction to prepare for next time.
notebook.empty: No writing errors yet. The notebook updates automatically after grading.
notebook.exactMatch: This exercise compares your answer with the suggested correction, including capitals and punctuation. Other valid phrasing may not be recognised.

revisions.title: Rewrite and compare
revisions.intro: Revise your current text, get fresh feedback and compare earlier attempts.
revisions.error: Could not grade this revision. Your text is still here.
revisions.rewardNote: Revisions do not award additional completion XP.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen to learn faster — no browser needed.
pwa.iosHint: Tap the Share button, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.

push.title: Want a daily nudge?
push.body: Turn on notifications so you do not forget to review. You can switch them off any time in Settings.
